appName.message: FontSnap: AI Font Identifier from Image
appName.description: Extension name (Chrome Web Store, max 75 chars)

appDesc.message: Snap any text with this AI font identifier from image: a font finder and font matcher that shows the 5 closest Google typefaces.

ctxImage.message: FontSnap: identify font in this image

ctxSelect.message: FontSnap: select an area to identify font

selectHint.message: FontSnap: drag over the text (Esc to cancel)

tagline.message: AI font identifier · runs on your device

dropHint.message: Paste (Ctrl+V) or drop an image with text, or choose a file.

dropTip.message: Tip: click the FontSnap toolbar icon on any page and drag over text.

ready.message: Ready. Paste, drop or choose an image.

noLines.message: No clear text lines found — result may be unreliable. Try a tighter selection.

captureFail.message: Capture failed: $ERR$ — try again or paste a screenshot.

previewPh.message: Type your own text (default: The quick brown fox…)

note.message: Matches Google Fonts families. Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic work best; Chinese/Japanese are still weak. Images never leave your computer; font previews are loaded from Google Fonts.

doneInLoad.message: Done in $TOTAL$ ms (model load $LOAD$ ms + analysis $MS$ ms)

wPin1.message: Click the puzzle icon in the top-right corner of Chrome.

wPin3.message: Click the pin icon next to it.

wPinned.message: Already pinned? Show how to use it

wUse1.message: Click the FontSnap icon or press Alt+Shift+F, then drag over any text on the page.

wUse2.message: Right-click an image and choose “Identify font in this image”.

wUse3.message: Or open FontSnap and paste, drop or upload a screenshot.

wUse4.message: Get the 5 closest Google Fonts, compare previews and copy the CSS.

wPrivacy.message: Everything runs on your device. Images are never uploaded.
